name: Suzano S.A.
share_adj_basis: applied to revenue components only (v5.4); OE/share CAGR enters unadjusted

ads_ratio.source: Suzano Form 20-F for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2024 (filed 2025-04-28), Note 1 (Company's operations): Suzano's ADRs, 'in a ratio of 1 (one) per common share', Level II, are traded on the NYSE under the ticker SUZ; corroborated by BNY Mellon depositary notices through April 2026 showing Ratio (Local Shares:DRs) 1:1
ads_ratio.reason: EDGAR per-share figures are per ordinary share and the Nasdaq price is per ADS; at a 1:1 ratio the two are identical, so no scaling changes any figure — the field exists so make_score does not refuse on DATA_GAP:ads_ratio

fx_conversion.source: frankfurter.app — ECB reference rates (closest business day to each period end)

overrides_applied.source: Anchor: last SBC value filed under the engine's tags is FY2021 R$99,740,000 (financials_history.csv: US$17,902,333 at the FY2021 period-end ECB rate 0.17949 in dcf_numbers.json fx_conversion). Cash-flow compilations of Suzano's own statements put share-based compensation at R$42.1M (FY2023) / R$99.1M (FY2024) / R$92.1M (FY2025); the override takes the highest of the three recent years. Declared in BRL, the reporting currency; the engine FX-converts at period-end rates.
overrides_applied.reason: DATA_GAP:sbc — SBC missing for fiscal years 2023, 2024, 2025 under the engine's AdjustmentsForSharebasedPayments tag (the filer stops tagging the cash-flow addback after FY2021; statements.json likewise finds only equity-statement / key-management share-based tags for those years). The value is 0.99x the last filed anchor, inside the 0.1x-10x estimate band, and is the maximum of the three gap years' compiled figures, so it errs conservative (more SBC = lower OE). SBC at this level is ~0.2% of revenue and ~1% of owner's earnings — immaterial to the verdict either way; the engine measures the exact impact in override_impact.

fragility_flags: STALE_FY: latest fiscal year ended 10 months ago — check TTM/quarterly OE and consider --base-oe-ps override
BUYBACK_TAILWIND: share count shrinking 2.3%/yr — already credited via the growth adjustment
NI_OCF_DIVERGENCE: net income and operating cash flow differ by >40% in 2024 — find the one-off (tax deposits, impairments, WC swings) before trusting the OE base

FX_CONVERTED: reporting currency BRL converted to USD at period-end ECB reference rates (frankfurter.app) — flow facts use the period-end rate, not a period average; the rates used are recorded in dcf_numbers.json fx_conversion

ADS_RATIO_APPLIED: 20-F filer — per-share figures scaled x1.0 ordinary shares per ADS (Suzano Form 20-F for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2024 (filed 2025-04-28), Note 1 (Company's operations): Suzano's ADRs, 'in a ratio of 1 (one) per common share', Level II, are traded on the NYSE under the ticker SUZ; corroborated by BNY Mellon depositary notices through April 2026 showing Ratio (Local Shares:DRs) 1:1) so they are comparable to the ADS price; TTM pins are taken as per-ADS already

OVERRIDE_APPLIED:sbc — filing gap in the last 3 FY filled by a judgment override (estimate: Anchor: last SBC value filed under the engine's tags is FY2021 R$99,740,000 (financials_history.csv: US$17,902,333 at the FY2021 period-end ECB rate 0.17949 in dcf_numbers.json fx_conversion). Cash-flow compilations of Suzano's own statements put share-based compensation at R$42.1M (FY2023) / R$99.1M (FY2024) / R$92.1M (FY2025); the override takes the highest of the three recent years. Declared in BRL, the reporting currency; the engine FX-converts at period-end rates.); an override never replaces a filed value — see overrides_applied and override_impact
BASE_DIVERGENCE: latest FY OE/share 1.98 vs 3-yr median 1.45 — one of them is distorted; find out which and why
WIDE_SCENARIO_SPREAD: super-bull IV is 4.8x super-bear IV — uncertainty is huge; confidence should not be high
HIGH_NET_DEBT: net debt is 8.1x normalized OE — levered OE can vanish fast; stress the bear cases
TIER_BAND: bear-case tier B (16.4%) vs bull-case tier S (28.0%) — the verdict spans tiers; size any position to the bear end

override_impact.basis: engine-native normalized base (median of last 3 FY) and weighted IRR, DCF run both ways (zero-fill baseline vs with-override); a --base-oe-ps TTM base is excluded from both sides — its override effect shows in ttm.py output
